zh: 修复移动端打开具体会话后无法左右滑动手势切换界面问题，重构消息滚动视图与横向滑动手势层级联动。
保险箱（Vault）新增通用 API Key 与 Secret 凭据安全托管，支持独立密文加密存储、界面操作与环境解析。
完善 iOS App Store 审核与移动端体验，脱敏并优雅格式化网络异常提示，补充合规隐私政策规范与 iPad 适配支持。
en: Fix mobile gesture navigation inside chat conversations by resolving vertical ScrollView and horizontal drawer/tab pan arbitration.
Introduce native API Key and Secret credential vault support with encrypted storage, management UI, and runtime injection.
Improve mobile network resilience and App Store compliance with elegant error masking, privacy policy documentation, and iPad layout support.
